industry.headline: EU Announces Plans to Mandate Age Verification for Social Media and AI Platforms
industry.summary: The EU is moving toward a bloc-wide age-assurance regime for social media and online services, following national moves like France's under-15 ban. Adds to the global regulatory patchwork (Australia, France, US state laws) and pressures UK regulators to harmonize — reinforcing NOMO's narrative that schools and brands need proactive, incentive-based alternatives (like NOMO) rather than pure restriction, and strengthens CEO Leonardo's UK/US/AU policy engagement.

industry.headline: Fintech Pulse: Split Pay's $125M Raise, Perk's US Spend Launch Highlight Rewards/Payments Funding Wave
industry.summary: Fresh capital into consumer rewards/spend platforms (Split Pay's $125M raise, Perk's US launch) signals continued investor appetite for rewards-tech infrastructure — a positive market backdrop for NOMO's rewards marketplace as it pushes its US go-to-market.

new_candidates.name: Dayo (Dayo Deals)
new_candidates.why_fits: Dayo's 'Dayo Deals' pays teens cash for hitting screen-time goals via brand partners (Starbucks, Adidas) — a direct competitive model to NOMO's reward-for-offline-time approach targeting the same teen audience.

new_candidates.name: Blok
new_candidates.why_fits: Physical NFC device paired with an Apple Screen Time API blocking app, positioning it as a leading 'app block' competitor alongside Brick and Opal — entities NOMO already tracks against.

new_candidates.name: BePresent
new_candidates.why_fits: Combines app blocking, gamification, social competition with friends, and real-life rewards to cut phone use — the same core reward-for-reduced-screen-time mechanic NOMO runs, aimed at the same audience.

new_candidates.name: TikTok (in-app digital wellbeing rewards)
new_candidates.why_fits: New badge rewards for staying within self-set limits, avoiding late-night use, and recruiting friends directly mirrors NOMO's reward-for-reduced-screen-time mechanic, at platform scale with the same teen demographic.
